text:
Nina (Sales Ops): Flagging a partner ask from BrightRoute (channel reseller). They had a big onboarding spike and the partner invoice hit $27,800. Partner requests a one-time onboarding rebate of $15k to be issued as credit if they execute the annual reseller agreement within 10 days.

Omar (Finance): Need to see invoice breakout and confirm if rebate should be amortized or recognized as contra-revenue immediately. Also: do we require repayment if partner cancels before term?

Nina (Sales Ops): Invoice split: 
```
- Gen tokens (customer usage): $12,400
- Embeddings batch: $6,200
- Portal support & custom setup: $4,800
- Data egress / infra: $4,400
- TOTAL: $27,800
Proposal: Rebate $15,000 issued as credit memo applied to next 3 partner invoices ($5k/mo) conditional on signed 12-month reseller agreement (min commit $8k/mo). If they fail to sign, rebate void and credit reversed.
```

Lee (RevOps): For forecasting treat as contra-revenue; amortize the credit over the 3 months. We should add a CRM flag and block partner auto-offer emails during the rebate window. Also recommend limiting finance exposure to $12,000 and require signed agreement before issuing any credit.

Omar (Finance): I can approve up to $12,000 contingent on: 1) executed reseller agreement within 10 business days, 2) rebate amortized across the 3 partner invoices, 3) GL posting to "partner_rebates_q2", and 4) legal-approved clawback clause.

Harper (Legal): I'll draft a short amendment with clawback/refund trigger if partner terminates or materially breaches in first 12 months. Need clarity on what constitutes "material breach" 1 (suggest: non-payment, repeated SLA violations, or data policy breaches). Will route to legal@redwood for countersign.

Nina (Sales Ops): Sounds good. Partner says they'll sign ASAP if we approve the $15k ask, but sales accepts the $12k cap. We'll push for signature today.

billing-bot: Credit memo draft created: CM-2026-222 (amount: $12,000) status: pending finance approval and legal countersign.

Omar (Finance): Final: approved $12,000 with conditions above. Billing, hold issuance until executed agreement is uploaded to S3 and legal confirms clause. Please tag invoice CM-2026-222 and update forecast grid.

Lee (RevOps): I'll add the CRM rebate flag and renewal trigger. Also will set an automated task to validate the signed agreement on day 5 and again on day 10. :white_check_mark:

Nina (Sales Ops): Thanks team 1 I'll chase the partner and post update in this thread when signed.
